faq.q: What is Agent as a Service?
faq.a: Agent as a Service is a subscription to managed AI agents that complete tasks across your tools, rather than software your team has to operate.

faq.q: How is AaaS different from automation tools?
faq.a: Automation tools follow fixed rules you set up. AI agents understand requests, decide the next step and handle variation, while asking a person when unsure.

faq.q: Is our data safe with AI agents?
faq.a: Agents run with the least access they need, sensitive actions require approval, and every action is logged for review.

faq.q: How quickly can an agent go live?
faq.a: A first agent for one workflow is usually designed, connected and tested in a few weeks, then expanded.

faq.q: Can you work on an app built with Lovable, Bolt or Replit?
faq.a: Yes. We take over code generated by AI builders and coding assistants, review it and continue development on a clean foundation.

faq.q: Do we need to rebuild from scratch?
faq.a: Usually not. We keep what works, fix the root causes and only rebuild the parts that cannot be made reliable.

faq.q: What do you fix first?
faq.a: Anything that blocks launch or puts users at risk: security gaps, broken payments and critical bugs come first.

faq.q: Will I still own the code?
faq.a: Yes. The code stays in your repository and accounts, and you keep full ownership.
